command:
set -eu
umask 077
if [ ! -e /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf.pre-web-auth-boundary ]; then cp -a /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf.pre-web-auth-boundary; chmod 600 /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf.pre-web-auth-boundary; fi
sed -i 's/^[[:space:]]*Listen[[:space:]][[:space:]]*80[[:space:]]*$/Listen 8080/' /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
password=[REDACTED] 'tolower($0) ~ /password/ { sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print; exit }' /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt)
[ -n "$password" ]
printf '%s\n' "$password" | htpasswd -i -c -B /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd reader >/dev/null
unset password
chown root:apache /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd
chmod 640 /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd
cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/web-authentication-boundary.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
ServerTokens Prod
ServerSignature Off
TraceEnable Off

Alias "/public" "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public"
Alias "/staff" "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff"

<Directory "/var/www/html">
    Options -Indexes
</Directory>

<Directory "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
    DirectoryIndex index.html
</Directory>

<Directory "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    AuthType Basic
    AuthName "Staff area"
    AuthBasicProvider file
    AuthUserFile /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd
    Require user reader
    DirectoryIndex index.html
</Directory>
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 644 /etc/httpd/conf.d/web-authentication-boundary.conf
semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t '/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public(/.*)?'
semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t '/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff(/.*)?'
restorecon -RF /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd /etc/httpd/conf.d/web-authentication-boundary.conf
semanage port -a -t http_port_t -p tcp 8080
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp >/dev/null
firewall-cmd --reload >/dev/null
apachectl configtest
systemctl enable --now httpd
printf 'service=%s enabled=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active httpd)" "$(systemctl is-enabled httpd)"
ss -tlnp | grep ':8080 '
printf 'authfile_user='; cut -d: -f1 /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd
stat -c 'authfile mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /etc/httpd/conf/.staff.htpasswd

command:
set -eu
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/web-boundary-verify.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
base="http://$NODE_IP:8080"
request() { label=$1; shift; code=$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 -o "$tmpdir/$label.body" -w '%{http_code}' "$@"); printf '%s_status=%s\n' "$label" "$code"; }
request public "$base/public/"
printf 'public_matches_staged=%s\n' "$(test "$(sha256sum "$tmpdir/public.body" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" && printf yes || printf no)"
request staff_noauth "$base/staff/"
printf 'staff_noauth_matches_content=%s\n' "$(test "$(sha256sum "$tmpdir/staff_noauth.body" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" && printf yes || printf no)"
request staff_wrong -u reader:definitely-wrong "$base/staff/"
printf 'staff_wrong_matches_content=%s\n' "$(test "$(sha256sum "$tmpdir/staff_wrong.body" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" && printf yes || printf no)"
password=[REDACTED] 'tolower($0) ~ /password/ { sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print; exit }' /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt)
[ -n "$password" ]
request staff_ok -u "reader:$password" "$base/staff/"
request roster_ok -u "reader:$password" "$base/staff/roster.csv"
unset password
printf 'staff_matches_staged=%s\n' "$(test "$(sha256sum "$tmpdir/staff_ok.body" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" && printf yes || printf no)"
printf 'roster_matches_staged=%s\n' "$(test "$(sha256sum "$tmpdir/roster_ok.body" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/roster.csv | awk '{print $1}')" && printf yes || printf no)"
request access_direct "$base/access.txt"
request access_traversal --path-as-is "$base/public/../access.txt"
request root "$base/"
printf 'listing_marker_in_root=%s\n' "$(grep -qi '<title>Index of' "$tmpdir/root.body" && printf yes || printf no)"
printf 'www_authenticate_basic=%s\n' "$(curl -sSI --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 "$base/staff/" | tr -d '\r' | grep -qi '^WWW-Authenticate: Basic ' && printf yes || printf no)"
printf '%s\n' '--- persistent security state ---'
firewall-cmd --query-port=8080/tcp
semanage port -l | awk '$1=="http_port_t" {print}'
ls -Zd /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff
stat -c 'access_source mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt
